pair_summary_definition: For each of the 20 informative seed pairs, count candidate-consistent and candidate-inconsistent assignments. Retain the complete metric names in both sets and candidate zero-difference names separately.
failure_set_definition: For each candidate, retain every informative pair whose frozen consistency flag is false. Candidate zero differences remain in that set and are also listed separately. Jump-tie pairs are not part of these 20 structural summaries and remain unchanged in the source.
shared_failure_spectrum_definition: For every integer k from 0 through 16, report the number and identity of informative pairs with exactly k inconsistent candidates. Do not merge k values into new categories.
overlap_definition: For each of the 120 candidate pairs, compute failure-set intersection, union, shared pairs and one-sided counts. Jaccard is intersection_count / union_count when union_count > 0 and null otherwise.
closest_comparison_definition: Compare the two candidates with the smallest inconsistent-pair counts in the frozen source, q99 and block_std_max, including shared and one-sided failing pairs. This is not an ensemble or revised acceptance rule.
